    for c in pivc.columns:
        y = pivc[c]
        before = y.loc[D-pd.Timedelta(days=hist):D-pd.Timedelta(days=1)]
        after = y.loc[D:D+pd.Timedelta(days=window-1)]
        m,s = before.mean(), before.std(ddof=1)
        stat = (after.mean()-m)/(s/np.sqrt(hist))
        out.append((c, m, after.mean(), stat, (after.mean()-m)/m))
    r = pd.DataFrame(out, columns=['fam','before','after','tstat','rel']).set_index('fam')
    return r
for w,h in [(1,30),(3,30),(7,30),(14,45),(7,45)]:
